A '''monocle''' was a single lens worn over one eye to improve a being's eyesight. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Glaucus (Human)|Glaucus]] of the ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]'' wore a monocle.<ref name="Betrayal">{{WEGCite|story=The Art of Betrayal|book=The Politics of Contraband}}</ref> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Snoova]] wore a one-piece [[monocle ocular enhancer|monocle unit]] with a minitaurized [[Infrared receptor|infrared scanner]] fitted to it.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

An [[Unidentified Naboo artist|artist]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] wore a [[Monocle/Legends|monocle]] while painting.<ref name="Visionaries">{{StoryCite|story=The Artist of Naboo|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>
